Product Manager, Payments

Example Co is hiring a Product Manager to own the payments roadmap. You will write PRDs, run experiments, partner with engineering and design, and define success metrics for checkout conversion.

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years of product management experience in fintech or e-commerce.
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills; comfortable with dashboards and funnels.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and written communication across time zones.
  • Experience with A/B testing and experimentation platforms at scale.
